title: Grateful Dead Live at Sacramento Memorial Auditorium on 1972-08-12
lineage: SBD Reel master > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1972 show highlighted by a smoking The Other One/Black Peter sandwich and stellar Playin', though Donna's vocals divide listeners.
ai_review.review: The recording offers generally crisp, well‑balanced soundboard audio with only minor drop‑outs noted by a few reviewers. Musically the concert shines with an explosive Other One jam, a rare Black Peter sandwich, and a powerful Playin' that many fans call smoking, while vocal quirks from Donna Jean are the most common criticism. Overall the performance is high‑energy and memorable.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews rate the show 4–5 stars, praising both the musical peaks and generally good soundboard quality; only a few low‑star or off‑topic comments lower the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and crisp with balanced instrument mix; a handful of listeners mention minor cuts or drop‑outs but nothing that seriously impedes enjoyment.

poor_songs: Playing in the Band (vocals) – Donna's screeching noted as distracting by several reviewers
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong sequencing with a notable Other One → Black Peter sandwich and solid transitions; first set considered average but overall flow praised.

band_member_comments.Phil: Drops a few 'bombs' and delivers beautiful harmonies on Bird Song, noted positively.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby's guitar intro on Playin' is highlighted as trippy and unusually forward in the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith praised for great Rhodes tone and an epic wa‑wa pedal performance during The Other One jam.
